text:
Priya K: Heads-up — Orchard private cutover is scheduled this Friday 00:00–02:00 UTC. Window requested by account team; plan below. Can folks confirm ownership and any blockers?

Alex M: I can take the deployment lead and rollback. Will be on call for the window.

Samir R: I can do smoke tests + post-cutover validation. Which canary percentage are we doing?

Priya K: Thanks. Plan is 5% canary for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then full. No DB schema changes, just model + runtime config and a small KMS key rotation.

Jill O: Confirming ops runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/orchard-cutover — everyone has RW?

Darren (customer-eng): Customer will have an on-site VPN jumpbox for access. They've given us an allowlist for the maintenance IPs.

Alex M: Good. Two quick asks: 1) who has access to the customer's HSM/KMS during the window? 2) Is there a maintenance page to flip if rollback is needed?

Priya K: KMS access: Jill has cust-admin, Darren has delegated key ops. We need to coordinate key rotation steps — see snippet below. Maintenance page: yes, toggle at https://status.redwood/maintenance (internal toggle + statuspage post).

Samir R: Smoke checklist draft:
- sanity curl to /health and /v1/generate on canary nodes
- run sample prompts (3 short, 2 long) to confirm streaming for long tails
- embedding quality quick compare (sample hash)
- KV cache warmup check (redis hits)

Samir R: Commands I'll run:
```bash
# check rollout
kubectl -n orchard rollout status deploy/redwood-orchard --watch 
# health
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://orchard-api.internal/health
```

Alex M: Rollback plan (short):
1) Abort canary -> set traffic to previous variant in ingress (istio)
2) kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-orchard -n orchard
3) if KMS rotation applied, revert key alias to previous alias in KMS (Jill + Darren)
4) post-rollback smoke run (Samir)

Jill O: KMS rotation note: we'll create new key alias `alias/orchard-v2-temp`, update config, verify, then retire previous alias after 24h. We'll stage the alias swap in a dry-run 1h before window.

Priya K: Dependencies:
- Network team to confirm jumpbox firewall rules done by Thu EOD (Darren is coordinating)
- Storage team to confirm snapshot at -30m before cutover
- Monitoring: create temporary alerts for error-rate spike and tail-latency > 400ms

Darren (customer-eng): Network team confirmed; firewall will be applied at Thu 22:00 UTC. Customer storage snapshot scheduled Fri 23:25 UTC (their TZ note).

Alex M: Can someone add a small smoke script to the deployment CI that Samir can call so we avoid manual curl copy/paste? E.g., `scripts/smoke-orchard.sh` — just 3 checks.

Jill O: I'll push the smoke script to the cutover branch now and open a tiny PR — will tag @AlexM and @SamirR.

OpsBot: Reminder: on-call rotation — @Alex M is primary for 1718001234 window, secondary is @Jill O.

Samir R: Two more validation items: 1) confirm KV cache TTLs carried over after rollout; 2) verify model quantization bits (should be same) — will include in smoke script.

Priya K: Quick risk register:
- KMS alias swap failing -> medium -> rollback to previous alias
- Unexpected latency spike from new runtime path -> high -> abort canary and roll back
- Customer VPN flakiness -> medium -> extend window + escalate to customer-eng

Alex M: Can we do a preflight 1h before window (Fri 23:00 UTC)? Dry-run: config apply in staging, smoke script run, manual KMS alias swap in dry mode. Who's available for that?

Jill O: I'll be available for preflight at 23:00 UTC. Will coordinate dry-run steps in the runbook.

Darren (customer-eng): Customer rep will be on call for the preflight as well.

Priya K: Awesome. Action items: 
- Alex M: lead deploy + rollback (assign owner)
- Samir R: smoke test checklist + script (provide PR)
- Jill O: KMS alias dry-run + push smoke script PR
- Darren: confirm firewall & customer jumpbox access by Thu EOD
- Monitoring: create alerts and dashboard (I can do)

Alex M: I'll create a small checklist in the runbook and ping here when ready.

Samir R: PR for smoke script incoming in ~20m.

Jill O: PR opened — link: https://git.internal/redwood/orchard/pull/382 (tagged @AlexM @SamirR)

Priya K: Great. We'll reconvene here after preflight. If anything changes, update the runbook and ping @channel. :thumbsup:

Alex M: noted. See you all Fri.

(End of thread)
